title: Length bound for concatenated words
statement: Let $A$ be a type, $x$ a finite list of elements of $A$, $f$ a function from $A$ to bit strings, and $c$ a natural number. If every element occurring in $x$ maps to a bit string of length at least $c$, then the concatenation of the images has length at least $c$ times the length of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps elements of $A$ to bit strings
Every element of $x$ maps to a bit string of length at least $c$
replaced:
If every element of a finite list maps under a function $f$ to a bit string of
length at least $c$, then the concatenation of all these bit strings, in list
order, has length at least $c$ times the length of the list.
